data.title: US shift to Iran sanctions reveals failed military strategy, experts say | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: Despite the apparent success of the US’s blockade and sanctions campaign, Iranian officials have repeatedly expressed that they would not falter in maintaining control over the Strait of Hormuz.
